payload.detail: RECONSTRUCTED AND CONFIRMED 2026-09-06 by reading scripts/ledger-inbox.mjs. --dry-run is parsed once, at line 781, inside the RECONCILE path only, and is consulted at lines 801, 839 and 841. No other subcommand reads it. So 'issues:add -- --dry-run', and likewise done, update, queue and cancel, silently write a real immutable request file into docs/outstanding-issues-inbox/ while the operator believes nothing was written. The failure is silent in both directions: no warning that the flag is unsupported, and no output distinguishing a rehearsal from a real write. NEXT ACTION: either honour --dry-run in the shared request-writing helper (print the request that would be written and exit 0 without writing), or reject the flag with a non-zero exit on the subcommands that do not support it. Rejecting is the safer of the two, because a flag that is accepted and ignored is what caused this. Verify by running an add with --dry-run and confirming the inbox file count is unchanged.
